subject: Confirm your portal access
body: To comply with the annual access review, we ask all users to confirm their portal credentials. Please reply to this message with your username so we can mark your account as reviewed. This step is required for all active accounts and takes less than a minute. Accounts that are not confirmed will be listed for review, which may temporarily affect access to internal systems. You will not need to change anything else, we only need the username to close the review ticket.
hook: Mimics a routine compliance review to get an employee to volunteer their username.
